editorial:
Imagine having your whole life planned out, only to have it fall apart in a heartbeat. That is exactly what happens to Leah, a successful woman who thinks she has found her forever partner. When her boyfriend tells her he does not want the same future she does, she is left totally crushed. Just when she is at her lowest, she meets Carter. He is handsome, sweet, and seems like the answer to all her prayers. At first, the movie feels like a romantic dream, but it quickly shifts into a nightmare. You will feel the tension build as Carter's sweet mask slips, revealing a scary, controlling man who refuses to take no for an answer.

What really makes this movie work is how it keeps you on edge. The acting is solid, and the way the mood changes from love to fear is handled well. While some of the plot points feel a bit predictable, the suspense keeps you glued to your seat. If you enjoy stories about dangerous obsessions, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Carter tries to kidnap Leah and force her to be with him. After a scary struggle, Leah manages to fight back and defend herself. She eventually escapes his grasp and the police step in to stop him. Carter is arrested for his crimes, and Leah is finally safe. The movie wraps up with her moving on from the trauma and finding her own strength again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about escaping toxic relationships.
